objective: Introduce System Admin security signal monitoring, audited Finance V3 containment and evidence-gated recovery without interrupting existing app features.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-12 read-only: 542 public tables RLS on, 58 anon admin-definer RPCs, existing BSOC/capacity/fraud tables, Finance V3 all switches OFF, Auth audit entries 24h none. Exact security migration passed BEGIN/ROLLBACK-only SQL simulation including finance guard; no live mutation.; 2026-11-12 PR #735 merged at 9ce38850fb66d8f587dce72cd1b3380148a31098 and applied to production: anonymous admin RPC count 0, 105 authenticated admin RPCs retained, all four Finance V3 switches OFF.
chosenApproach: Private metadata-only 15-minute risk scan, System Admin-only dashboard and controlled Finance V3 hold with a database guard, immutable actions, optimistic versioning, MFA-evidenced hold release; reuse existing admin navigation.
selectionRationale: Precise fail-safe operations retain historical finances and existing login/video/ads functionality while establishing incident detection and containment without paid dependencies.
alternativeApproaches: Auto-ban accounts on heuristic signals: rejected for destructive false positives.
Build separate paid security provider first: rejected as unnecessary prerequisite to database hardening.
Pure checklist-only controls: rejected due lack of enforced finance hold.
preserveBehaviors: No payout activation or historical ledger mutations
No UI changes to Wall, media, Marites, PTT, ads, Bible, Quiz
Existing BSOC and Admin routes remain unchanged
No automatic data restore or mass account block
acceptanceChecks: Node regression tests and TypeScript compile
Mandatory Engineering Accountability and relevant CI checks pass
DB read-only post-deployment checks pass after controlled promotion
Actual Finance hold behavior proven in safe environment; no payout enablement
Production exact release artifact and source SHA verified before calling live
Exact-source Android and Expo Web compiled RC QA run must pass before production merge
